title: When May a Model Replace the Experiment? Audits, Licenses, and the Price of Trust in Surrogate-Driven Design
abstract: arXiv:2608.01378v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Design campaigns in chemistry, materials science, and machine learning share a bottleneck: determining how good a candidate truly is requires an expensive evaluation - an experiment, a first-principles simulation, or a full training run. Machine-learning surrogates that predict these outcomes are increasingly used not only to propose candidates but to grade them, and even to feed their own predictions back into the search as though they were measurements. Through mathematical analysis validated on three exhaustively ground-truthed design tasks, we establish when this practice is safe, what any certificate of safety must cost, and when the substitution provably pays. Predictive accuracy cannot anchor trust: near-perfect R^2 is compatible with worst-possible selections, and screening N candidates inflates the over-prediction at the selected candidate by a quantifiable "selection tax" with matching upper and lower bounds. Safety follows

translated_title: 模型何时可以替代实验？代理驱动设计中的审计、许可与信任代价
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.01378v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：化学、材料科学和机器学习中的设计活动共享一个瓶颈：确定候选方案的真实优劣需要昂贵的评估——无论是实验、第一性原理模拟，还是完整的训练运行。用于预测这些结果的机器学习代理模型，如今不仅用于提出候选方案，还用于为其评分，甚至将其自身预测作为测量结果反馈到搜索过程中。通过对三个经过全面真实标注的设计任务进行数学分析并验证，我们确定了这种做法何时是安全的、任何安全证书必须付出何种代价，以及何时这种替代被证明是值得的。预测准确性无法锚定信任：接近完美的R²可能与最差的选择相容，筛选N个候选方案会在选定方案处放大过度预测，产生一个可量化的“选择税”，并伴有匹配的上下界。安全性遵循以下原则……
tldr: 本文通过数学分析证明，代理模型在设计中替代实验的安全性与预测准确性无关，需通过审计和许可机制来量化“选择税”并确保信任，且仅在特定条件下替代才值得。
en_tdlr: This paper mathematically proves that the safety of replacing experiments with surrogate models in design is independent of predictive accuracy, requiring audits and licenses to quantify the "selection tax" and ensure trust, with substitution only paying off under specific conditions.
